753:t_146:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Lady $$ディアナ$$ has endured that loneliness and sorrow...! She never took joy in it with a smile like you do!」

753:t_146:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「After all, she is only human. I, who have become a god, have surpassed even that!」

753:t_146:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If losing one's human heart is what it means to become a god, then I deny the very existence of gods...!」

753:t_146:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「To protect the lovable world that Lady $$ディアナ$$ and the young lady taught me...! $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, I will stop you!!」

753:t_147:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It's a pity, $$アムロ$$. Had a human like you been born sooner, the universe might have been saved.」

753:t_147:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not too late yet...! If we defeat you and stop the universe's great collapse, humanity will go on toward the future again!」

753:t_147:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Impossible. To begin with, the universe's collapse cannot be stopped.」

753:t_147:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even if you did stop it, a world without me would be swallowed by chaos, and humanity would merely walk the road to self-destruction.」

753:t_147:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A self-intoxicated god wannabe is more trouble than an intellectual revolutionary!」

753:t_147:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't talk about your own delusions as if they were fact...! Humanity isn't as foolish as you think!」

753:t_147:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll prove it! By defeating an obstacle like you and showing the path that leads to the future!!」

753:t_148:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$... You have been unfortunate.」

753:t_148:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Born as $$ブライト・ノア$$'s son, drawn to $$クェス$$, a girl tossed about by $$アムロ$$ and $$シャア$$, you throw yourself into the flames of war to save her...」

753:t_148:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But those days of unwanted fighting are over. I will save you.」

753:t_148:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「That's none of your business! I'm fighting of my own free will!」

753:t_148:5.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Sure, at first it was to save $$クェス$$, but now I intend to save many more people, not just $$クェス$$!」

753:t_148:6.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「So I won't lose! Not to a selfish person like you!!」

753:t_149:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What god!? Don't you dare call yourself that, you who smile while watching the universe perish!」

753:t_149:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're wrong, $$カミーユ$$. It is precisely because I am a god that I can endure even this anguish that makes my chest feel ready to burst.」

753:t_149:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And together with your memories, I will depart for a new world... to lead the world in the right direction this time.」

753:t_149:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You have no right to decide what's right for the world! That's for those who live in it to decide!」

753:t_149:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What you're trying to do is hypocrisy born of ego! Understand that!」

753:t_149:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are the one who should understand, $$カミーユ$$. I have the right and the power to decide everything!」

753:t_149:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then we'll smash it! We, who are just ordinary humans!」

753:t_149:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And we'll make you understand, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! That humanity still needs a future!!」

753:t_150:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Poor $$フォウ$$, who has no past... I will save you.」

753:t_150:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「You understand nothing! What I want isn't the past, it's the future!」

753:t_150:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I will give you that future. In the form of new life in a new world.」

753:t_150:3.en:
$$フォウ$$
「You still don't understand! A future isn't something someone gives you!」

753:t_150:4.en:
$$フォウ$$
「We will seize the future with our own hands! By overcoming a great wall like you!!」

753:t_151:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You're a being that snuffs out possibility!」

753:t_151:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will carry humanity's possibility to a new world myself. There, humans will evolve correctly this time.」

753:t_151:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is correct evolution!? Do you have the right to decide that!」

753:t_151:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I can say with confidence that I do.」

753:t_151:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is the resolve I hold, having risen as a god.」

753:t_151:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Only humans have a god...! A god called possibility...!」

753:t_151:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you call yourself a god, our possibility will surpass even that!」

753:t_151:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That is the wish of the people who entrusted the future to us!!」

753:t_151:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're wrong, $$バナージ$$. The future is in my hands.」

753:t_151:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I will strike down that arrogance!」

753:t_151:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Answer my feelings, $$ユニコーン$$! So we can overcome him and grasp the future with our own hands!!」

753:t_152:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$リディ$$... You seem to be handling the $$バンシィ$$ I gave you well.」

753:t_152:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Back then, you taught me about the existence of the $$御使い$$s, along with the $$バンシィ$$...」

753:t_152:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Why did you tell me the truth?」

753:t_152:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I wanted to see what would be born when I gave you a Gundam, a product of the civilization of fire.」

753:t_152:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「You...! What do you take me and $$バナージ$$ for!? We're not your toys!」

753:t_152:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you overcame the trial and gained power. I would like you to be grateful for that.」

753:t_152:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then I'll show you that power... the power of humans!」

753:t_152:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「Our possibilities will surpass your schemes! I'll prove it!!」

753:t_153:0.en:
$$カツ$$
「Even if it's a god I'm up against!」

753:t_153:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That courage that could be called reckless... $$カツ$$, you are entertaining to watch.」

753:t_153:2.en:
$$カツ$$
「I know we can't beat you unless we go that far! I'll stake my life too!」

753:t_153:3.en:
$$カツ$$
「$$サラ$$! I will seize the future! The future you wished for!」

753:t_154:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$エマ$$... Once the fighting is over, you'll live on with the one you love, won't you?」

753:t_154:1.en:
$$エマ$$
「That's exactly why I won't accept something like the collapse of the universe!」

753:t_154:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your feelings will be fulfilled in the new world. I guarantee that myself.」

753:t_154:3.en:
$$エマ$$
「What I wish for isn't just my own personal happiness! As a soldier, I have a duty to protect everyone's freedom and peace!」

753:t_154:4.en:
$$エマ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I will eliminate you, the obstacle to that!」

753:t_155:0.en:
$$ファ$$
「I have to fight...! For everyone, for the universe!」

753:t_155:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You needn't be afraid, $$ファ$$. You have no need to fight.」

753:t_155:2.en:
$$ファ$$
「Don't decide how I live for me!」

753:t_155:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Saying that in a trembling voice isn't convincing at all.」

753:t_155:4.en:
$$ファ$$
「I'll still fight! Because I'm a human who lives in this world too!」

753:t_155:5.en:
$$ファ$$
「So I'll resist with everything I have! Because I want to protect the world I live in with my own strength!」

753:t_156:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You don't have to fight anymore, $$刹那$$.」

753:t_156:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In your childhood, you despaired of god, clung to a Gundam, and then surpassed the Gundam. ...But there is still something you cannot surpass.」

753:t_156:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes. I am the god you longed for in your childhood!」

753:t_156:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you really are a god, this time I can part ways with the very existence of gods...」

753:t_156:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You are no god! You are war itself!」

753:t_156:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「So we will surpass you! Believing in the future that lies beyond the fighting!」

753:t_156:10.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That wish will never come true!」

753:t_156:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll make it come true! That's why I've fought until today!」

753:t_156:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「I am $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$! A $$ガンダムマイスター$$ of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$! I will end the fighting and carve out the future!!」

753:t_157:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I shall repay you, who carried on your brother's name and have fought to this day.」
